svg.title: Coversaath product architecture
svg.desc: A detailed product architecture showing Coversaath's household health-insurance agent, its data model, specialist workers, state flows, human gates, external rails and safety boundaries.
svg.text: Household health-insurance understanding and decision agent. Detailed build map, not a claim-approval promise.
Version 20 September 2026 · Design proposal · all live institution integrations remain unverified
No household should reach an insurance decision or hospital admission without knowing what cover it has,
what remains uncertain, what money it may need and what it should do next.
Reconstruct group and personal cover first. Carry that same household context through buying, renewal, hospitalisation and claim coordination.

Coversaath explains and coordinates. It does not diagnose, promise cashless access, predict claim approval, bind an insurer, submit a declaration, buy cover or move money without the named adult's approval.
ENTRY: a real household event starts a bounded case
Do not begin with a generic dashboard. The trigger determines questions, permissions, urgency and the next worker plan.
Question: what must we clarify and fund?
Emergency rule: admit first. Optimise later.
Sets urgency, scope and immediate safe action. Creates a case ID. Routes emergency to hospital first, then returns to evidence work.
Output: trigger classification + allowed next actions + task plan.
CONTROL PLANE: household roles and permission are separate facts
Family relationship is not authority. Every collection, viewing, sharing and action checks the named adult's recorded permission.
Builds a role map for every relevant adult and child.
• Patient: health event may concern them
• Policyholder / proposer: policy or declaration owner
• Payer: premium or hospital cash source
• Operator: can locate and work the route
• Backup: optional person who may receive a handover
Permission record = person · source · purpose · viewer · allowed action · expiry · revocation · audit event.
No permission or unclear authority → ask the correct person or stop.
Permission tree enforced before every tool call
Task carries only needed fields, purpose and expiry.
Request permission, switch owner or log blocked state.
FACT BASE: source first, then extract, reconcile and label uncertainty
The system stores a cited fact, not a polished insurance story. Original documents and correspondence remain evidence, not instructions.
Creates source ID, owner, date, version, page/section,
Never treats an email, PDF or voice transcript as
No raw document upload until private storage, deletion
Reads source into typed, cited fields:
• insurer, TPA, HR and hospital contacts
Model use is bounded: structured output, source pointer,
schema validation, version and confidence captured.
Cannot decide cover, declare a fact or change source text.
Joins citations into a household coverage graph.
It compares sources, dates and policy versions.
NEEDS CONFIRMATION: rule or institution unclear
Unknown is not false. A brochure is not governing wording.
Continuous record and planning layer inside Coversaath.
Also stores task log, permissions, source map, action history,
DECISION ENGINE: agents plan work; specialist workers produce bounded evidence
No agent has direct provider authority. No agent runs a transaction. Orchestrator can only dispatch a permitted, versioned task to a worker.
Owns the case state machine, not insurance truth.
1. Reads trigger, permissions and evidence status
2. Selects smallest task plan for the current event
3. Dispatches workers with deadline, budget and scope
4. Rechecks consent and record revision before action
5. Stops on conflict, unknown material fact or failed worker
6. Builds a plain-language output with citations
Task budget · retries · lease · cancellation · revision check · cost/time cap
Cannot override a worker, institution, policy wording or human approval gate.
Tests this person + event + date against cited terms.
Eligibility · dates · waiting period · exclusion · room rule
co-pay · deductible · sum insured · restore · top-up attachment
Output is a condition map, never “claim will pass”.
Assigns each unanswered question to the owner.
Hospital desk · HR · TPA · insurer · licensed partner · household
Tracks outreach, response, deadline and source.
Cannot assume hospital network or cashless approval.
Uses voluntary savings and commitments only to show deposit /
possible exposure bands. Keeps insurance, cash, loans and
No borrowing, liquidation or investment advice or execution.
Question asked → answer → evidence → submission → acknowledgement
query → underwriting change → payment → issuance / endorsement
Issuance does not prove claim outcome.
Classifies emails, letters and call summaries.
Links sender, request, due date, attachment, response and
unresolved issue back to source map.
Does not send a reply, submit a form or represent
Creates cited cards: known cover, conditions, unknowns, tasks,
owners, money bands, documents and escalation path.
No invented precision. No medical or legal advice.
hospital admission / estimate · HR benefit status
It does not replace the owner.
CASE STATE MACHINE: happy flow, unhappy flow and return paths
missing consent · source conflict · unanswered material question · deadline missed · worker failure · payment / issuance mismatch · institutional rejection or dispute
→ mark the exact blocker, preserve evidence, notify the owner, hand off where needed, then return only to the state that new evidence can resolve.
WhatsApp / voice first. Simple web card when needed.
• Household Health Card: what we have / do not know / next
• Buying / renewal comparison with stated conflict controls
• Admission Readiness Brief: cited conditions, owners, documents, cash bands
• Claim Position Brief: timeline, clause, evidence, open questions
No “approved/rejected likely” score. No policy summary sold as certainty.
Use: multilingual voice intake, read-back, follow-up and assisted handoff.
Need to build: permission-scoped handoff carrying adult
consent, source provenance and unresolved facts.
Do not infer phone identity, authority, consent or completion
Use: approved hosted payment and reconciliation where
Need to build: approval → checkout → signed event →
Payment is not underwriting, issuance, endorsement
Do not use logistics to invent a document collection
workflow or a fake claims role.
No physical-document flow until a real service need

Build sequence: protected evidence store → durable worker runtime → bounded model gateway → real consent + operator verification → one rail adapter at a time → licensed-partner and issuance gates. Before that: synthetic data only.
